matching: one-to-one by primary message ID and overlapping exact source span; no kind-based alignment
claims: presence of material gold claim; duplicate/unmatched output is FP
speakersSubjects: separate (claim,entity-ID) tuples; null is absence, not a positive prediction
commitmentsDeadlines: commitment (claim,owner), and each nonnull due date/time/timezone plus non-none ambiguity tuple
conflicts: one flag per expected claim pair; reason checked independently
uncertainty: nonconflict (code,field,claim-set), reason must identify material source ambiguity; no text-exact reason match
unnecessaryReview: unique proposals with extra nonmaterial flags, plus unsupported/duplicate proposals; routine mandatory approval of useful claims is not unnecessary review
smallSampleLimitation: Passing permits only considering a separately authorized synthetic API trial, not real chats.
